HPE deliverables: HPE to create a python package to identify sensor drift based on two candidate approaches. The first approach will be based upon the change in distribution of metric values over a long enough period of time. The second approach will be based upon the change in correlation coefficient between a target metric and one of the correlated metrics. Other approaches will be investigated as we investigate the topic. 10 This report is available at no cost from NREL at www.nrel.gov/publications. Task 3.2.10: Deployment With High Performance Cluster Manager (HPCM) The AIOps solution will be containerized to allow deployment with HPCM. NREL to work with HPE to identify AIOps capabilities of interest to be deployed with HPCM. Examples include data analytics performed on CRC and CDU metrics, and select building systems metrics (e.g., those involved in optimization of the PUE). NREL deliverables: • NREL to support a demonstration of AIOps deployed with HPCM. NREL will prepare Eagle and other hardware, as necessary, to support the demonstration. NREL to work with HPE to identify AIOps capabilities of interest to be deployed with HPCM. • Use platform provided in Task 1 to host KM components and HPCM software. • NREL to help quantify the value of AIOps when deployed with HPCM, and provide documented suggestions for improvements. HPE deliverables: • HPE to provide production support and engineering for the integration of HPCM modules in the NREL data center. • HPE to provide estimates of computational and memory requirements for various anomaly detection pipelines. • HPE to provide documentation on how AIOps components interact with HPCM. • HPE to create an AIOps deployable package, including Docker files and external resources, for integration with HPCM. The package will target the inference phase. Task 3.2.11: Develop Requirements for Deploying With HPE’s Infosight After deploying with HPCM, HPE and NREL will work on developing the requirements for deploying with another HPE product called Infosight. Infosight is a Cloud-based data analytics platforms, which focuses on analytics for the IT hardware. The goal for this task is to develop an understanding of what it will take to deploy AIOps with HPCM and Infosight using the platform provided in Task 1, and within the NREL data center. If significant progress is made, a limited scope demonstration of AIOps with HPCM and Infosight will be conducted at NREL. Task 3.2.12: Edge-to-Core-to-Cloud Investigation Time and resources permitting, NREL and HPE will work together to investigate the feasibility of implementing a small-scale Edge-to-Cloud demonstration within the ESIF. An Edge device may be a Cooling Tower, whose controller is working with an HPE Edgeline server (to be identified). The Cloud will be represented by Eagle.
